DO NOT REDESIGN. IMPLEMENT EXACTLY THIS CORRECTION.

A. SPLIT FIRST TURN INTO TRANSPORT-ONLY MCP BINDING PRELOAD
1. Add explicit provider-session step/state `MCP_BINDING_PRELOAD` or smallest consistent equivalent.
2. Fresh provider-session sequence:
   a. create/open fresh conversation in reusable tab;
   b. exact Extra High/Pro UI proof;
   c. select exact Mission Control app;
   d. send one retrieval-only MCP preload prompt;
   e. wait for generation completion AND server-side current provider-session `tools/call get_supervisory_request_binding` success receipt;
   f. only after that receipt is visible in Mission Control, respect global pacing and send semantic `EXTRA_HIGH_DIRECT` or `EXTRA_HIGH_READER` in SAME conversation with no app reselection/MCP request.
3. If preload generation completes without current binding receipt, wait existing bounded receipt grace/reconciliation window, then mark FAILED/FAILED_RETRYABLE. Do not send semantic work.
4. Generic `/mcp` POST, initialize, tools/list, selected app chip, or prose is insufficient.
5. Do not reuse the failed final3 request/session for acceptance. Use fresh synthetic request/session.

B. PRELOAD PROMPT MUST BE MINIMAL
Intent:
`Mission Control binding preload only. Use the selected Mission Control app. Your only action in this turn is to call get_supervisory_request_binding exactly once with request_id <...>, supervisor_id <...>, and provider_session_id <...>. Do not reason, use GitHub, make a decision, write a receipt, or answer from values in this prompt/context instead of calling the tool. If the exact tool call is unavailable or fails, fail closed. After the tool result is loaded into this conversation, stop.`

No GitHub task. No #59/#61 write. No substantive reasoning. No Work delegation.

C. SEMANTIC PROMPTS AFTER PRELOAD
- EXTRA_HIGH_DIRECT: state binding is already loaded by preceding preload; do not invoke/reselect Mission Control. Use GitHub for substantive evidence; make bounded decision; write schema-v2 #59 with exact loaded binding.
- EXTRA_HIGH_READER: same rule; use loaded binding + GitHub evidence, then write schema-v2 #61 reader receipt. No MCP refresh.
- Pro reasoner / Extra High liveness checker / continue / writer remain MCP-free and use same-chat binding + GitHub receipts.
- Preload turn and MCP telemetry have semantic_authority:false.

D. IMPROVE MCP TOOL ROUTING DESCRIPTION ONLY
For `get_supervisory_request_binding`, update description/title metadata so it says in substance:
- ALWAYS call this tool when a selected Mission Control message supplies exact supervisory request_id, supervisor_id, and provider_session_id and asks to preload/read the live request binding.
- Never substitute prompt/context values for the live call.
- Read-only current exact binding; no evidence body/private worker state.
Keep input/output schemas and anonymous read-only security unchanged. No write tools, enumeration, or private data.

E. UNIVERSAL BROWSER TAB DISCIPLINE — DURABLE RULE
Owner-level universal rule, not worker-local:
1. Fresh conversation means New chat in CURRENT verified reusable ChatGPT tab, not a new browser tab by default.
2. Steady state: 1 managed ChatGPT tab.
3. Temporary transition/recovery max: 2 managed ChatGPT tabs.
4. Absolute hard ceiling: 3 managed ChatGPT tabs. Fail closed before opening another.
5. Replacement tab only when current tab irrecoverably unusable; close superseded tab immediately once replacement verified.
6. Never fan out duplicate tabs for the same task.
7. Doctor/status telemetry must include managed ChatGPT tab count.
8. Deterministically clean completed/superseded provider-session tabs so they do not accumulate.
9. Do not keep bootstrap/pinned tabs open merely for history if durable capability already exists.
10. Encode this in universal Work/Codex/browser guidance plus regression test so future workers inherit it. Do not overwrite unrelated global provenance/state.

F. TESTS
Add focused deterministic tests proving:
- fresh session uses same reusable tab/New chat instead of new target by default;
- hard tab ceiling prevents opening a fourth managed ChatGPT tab;
- completed session cleanup returns toward one-tab steady state;
- replacement-tab recovery closes superseded tab;
- preload prompt contains only binding retrieval, no GitHub/decision/stage work;
- semantic direct/reader cannot send before current-session MCP binding receipt;
- preload success -> semantic turn only after >=60s global pacing;
- semantic/direct/reader/pro/checker/continue/writer never reselect Mission Control after preload;
- generic MCP contact without tools/call cannot satisfy preload;
- stale provider-session receipt cannot satisfy new session;
- tool description contains explicit always-call routing language;
- existing #59/#61 cross-session replay rejection remains green.

Run focused tests first, then exactly one normal final hosted checkpoint if code changed:
- deterministic repo audit
- Mission Control tests/types/build
- relay tests/syntax
- CodeQL
No redundant green reruns.

G. HOTFIX / HOSTINGER
If code changes:
- push exact head
- deploy ONLY `mission-control-hotfix` via established exact-SHA codeload mechanism
- prove exact SHA/build/typecheck/daemon/health
- production untouched
- install exact same relay head on Hostinger

Preserve authenticated ChatGPT profile, native sandbox, loopback CDP, 90s poll, 60s global minimum submission interval, AUTO→8GB memory profile.

H. LIVE ACCEPTANCE — COMPLETE WITHOUT OWNER RELAY
1. Verify stable #60 capability still current; do not redo unless expired/invalid.
2. Queue a NEW harmless ordinary v3 synthetic request (not final3).
3. Reuse current verified ChatGPT tab, create New chat in same tab, allocate new provider_session_id.
4. Preload: Mission Control selected; minimal retrieval-only prompt. PASS requires actual server telemetry `tools/call get_supervisory_request_binding` for exact request/supervisor/provider_session and MC receipt admitted.
5. After >=60s from preload send, semantic Extra High direct turn in same conversation without app reselection. Require #59 canonical receipt admitted.
6. Clean/reuse tab; do not leave duplicate tabs.
7. Queue NEW harmless PRO_ESCALATED synthetic request.
8. Same reusable tab -> New chat; new provider_session_id; preload binding-only turn with actual MCP tool call.
9. After >=60s, Extra High reader uses existing binding + GitHub and writes #61 reader STAGE_COMPLETE/CONTINUE_REQUIRED.
10. Continue same-chat Pro reasoner -> paced Extra High liveness checker -> optional paced `continue` -> final Extra High writer, with NO follow-up MCP selection/call.
11. Require ordered session-bound #61 receipts and final #59 admission.
12. Verify public missed-webhook reconciliation for #59/#60/#61.
13. Capture all actual ChatGPT send timestamps; every adjacent actual submission >=60s.
14. Capture T0/peak/final RAM, available RAM, swap, browser RSS, relay RSS, systemd memory; no HARD pressure.
15. Provider source timestamp: prove only if genuinely available; never relabel capture/generation time. Record accurately if unavailable.
16. Do not manufacture a stuck turn solely to test recovery. If naturally triggered, verify same-chat paced recovery.

I. FINALIZATION
Update PR #58 and issue #53 with exact final head, CI, hotfix deploy, ordinary/escalated fresh-session URLs, preload MCP tool-call telemetry, #59/#61 receipts, no-follow-up-MCP evidence, send spacing, tab-count telemetry, memory metrics, timestamp status.

Leave relay normal sends disabled after smoke unless existing durable policy explicitly requires continuous activation.
Do not invent/register a Project Manager chat.
Do not delete old conversations; audit locators may remain, but no stale tab needs remain open.

Merge only if all terminal acceptance passes AND existing durable merge policy makes merge deterministic. Otherwise stop `MERGE_POLICY_DECISION_REQUIRED`.
Production promotion is NOT authorized; if acceptance otherwise complete, stop `PRODUCTION_PROMOTION_NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED`.
